tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind content areas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, the main content column.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar and recessed areas such as code wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and the hovered nav item.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card outlines, dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control outlines that must be seen (3:1 on surface and bg in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, inactive nav labels, on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps and mono labels. Still 4.5:1 on every surface; never lighter.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ink in light mode, lime in dark. Primary buttons, the active nav marker, progress bars and the logo mark. Fill only: text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Lime as text or icon on surface and bg: links, Live labels, the avatar initial. Deep lime in light mode so it stays readable.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Lime tint behind Live pills, the avatar and highlighted rows. Text on it uses accent-ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Live or succeeded: dot, icon and label text on surface. The brand lime; always paired with the word Live.

tokens.name: status-live-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Live pill. Text on it uses status-live.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Running or waking: dot, icon and label text on surface.

tokens.name: status-working-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Working pill. Text on it uses status-working.

tokens.name: status-needs
tokens.usage: Needs your decision: dot, icon and label text. Orange, the one warm colour in the product, so it stands out from the green.

tokens.name: status-needs-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Needs you pill. Text on it uses status-needs.

tokens.name: status-asleep
tokens.usage: Asleep or idle: dot and label text.

tokens.name: status-asleep-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Asleep pill.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed or blocked: dot, icon and label text on surface.

tokens.name: status-failed-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Failed pill. Text on it uses status-failed.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Good morning. Two things need you.
styles.usage: One per page at most: the home greeting.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ran at 8:00, found 3 new listings, emailed you.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in lists, nav labels, button text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata under a name, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and eyebrows. Always uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, log lines, cron expressions.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Times, costs, counts and IDs, where digits should line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls and between list items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav item and pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above page titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, tags, small chips, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Cards use borders, not shadows.
